titleEn: Number of Ways to Form a Target String Given a Dictionary
title: 通过给定词典构造目标字符串的方案数
summary: 所有词长度相同；从左到右选择递增列及该列任一词的字符来拼出 target，统计方案数。
insight: 预处理每一列各字母出现次数。依次处理列，用一维背包 dp[j] 表示已构成 target 前 j 个字符的方案数，倒序更新避免同列重复使用。
pitfalls: 选用的列下标必须严格递增
同列相同字符的不同单词分别贡献
一维状态必须倒序更新并取模

solutions.title: 列频次一维动态规划
solutions.idea: 把每列可选字符数作为组合转移系数。

code.java: class Solution { public int numWays(String[] words,String target){final int MOD=1_000_000_007;int length=words[0].length();int[][] count=new int[length][26];for(String word:words)for(int column=0;column<length;column++)count[column][word.charAt(column)-'a']++;long[] dp=new long[target.length()+1];dp[0]=1;for(int column=0;column<length;column++)for(int formed=Math.min(column,target.length()-1);formed>=0;formed--)dp[formed+1]=(dp[formed+1]+dp[formed]*count[column][target.charAt(formed)-'a'])%MOD;return (int)dp[target.length()];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numWays(words:Array<String>,target:String):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007L;val length=words[0].length;val count=Array(length){IntArray(26)};for(word in words)for(column in 0 until length)count[column][word[column]-'a']++;val dp=LongArray(target.length+1);dp[0]=1;for(column in 0 until length)for(formed in minOf(column,target.lastIndex) downTo 0)dp[formed+1]=(dp[formed+1]+dp[formed]*count[column][target[formed]-'a'])%mod;return dp[target.length].toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numWays(vector<string>& words,string target){const long long MOD=1000000007;int length=words[0].size();vector<array<int,26>> count(length);for(auto& word:words)for(int column=0;column<length;++column)++count[column][word[column]-'a'];vector<long long> dp(target.size()+1);dp[0]=1;for(int column=0;column<length;++column)for(int formed=min(column,(int)target.size()-1);formed>=0;--formed)dp[formed+1]=(dp[formed+1]+dp[formed]*count[column][target[formed]-'a'])%MOD;return dp[target.size()];} };
